audits.description: permuting training labels destroys any regression edge over a train-mean baseline and leaves no systematic OOS rank IC averaged over repeated shuffles
every fold's train label window ends strictly before its test block, the gap meets purge+embargo, and test blocks are disjoint and ordered
recomputing features from raw data sliced to date<=t exactly matches the pipeline's feature matrix
lagging every feature by one extra day does not materially improve OOS rank IC over the honest pipeline
labels cannot be produced without a full forward window; rows lacking one are NaN, never filled

a naive scaler fit on train+test differs materially from one fit on train-only, and the pipeline's own rolling-window features for train-period dates are unchanged whether or not future rows are appended
no negative prices, no long zero-volume runs, no unflagged >40% daily moves, dates strictly increasing
two fold fits/predicts with the same seed and inputs produce hash-identical OOS predictions

addendum.note: Post-hoc supplementary analyses, computed after the primary pre-registered verdict above. See specs/methodology.md addendum section. None of these alter the primary verdict.

neutralization.description: Post-hoc addendum: rank IC of raw OOS predictions vs predictions cross-sectionally residualized against 12-1 momentum per date. Diagnostic only, does not alter the primary pre-registered verdict.

regime_breakdown.description: Post-hoc addendum: rank IC split by realized-volatility regime (median split on trailing 21-day realized volatility of the equal-weight universe mean daily return) and per-ticker time-series Spearman IC. Diagnostic only, does not alter the primary pre-registered verdict.

cpcv.description: Post-hoc addendum: Combinatorial Purged Cross-Validation. Multiple train/test path combinations drawn from the same purged/embargoed six-month blocks as the primary walk-forward path, LightGBM refit per path with the SAME frozen hyperparameters (no tuning), rank IC computed per path. Diagnostic only, does not alter the primary pre-registered verdict.

pbo.note: Simplified single-config logit-PBO: fraction of CPCV paths where in-sample rank IC is above the cross-path in-sample median while out-of-sample rank IC is below the cross-path out-of-sample median, log-odds transformed. This is a diagnostic proxy for the one frozen config in this project, not the full multi-strategy Bailey et al. CSCV/PBO framework (which requires a searched candidate set of competing strategies to rank; this project's hyperparameters are fixed a priori, never tuned or searched).

diagnosis.description: Post-hoc addendum: diagnoses why the ML model underperformed the 12-1 momentum baseline, using only already-generated pipeline artifacts plus one deterministic seed-42 refit of the final CV fold for the hyperparameter-binding check. Diagnostic only, does not alter the primary pre-registered verdict.

hyperparameter_binding.note: Refit of the final CV fold (400 trees, 122436 training rows) shows a mean of 27.7 leaves per tree against the configured cap of 31 (max observed 31), with 14.0% of trees hitting the num_leaves cap. This does not show num_leaves consistently binding in this fold; min_child_samples or max_depth may be the tighter constraint here instead.

summary: vol_21d and vol_63d are redundant (Spearman rho=0.806), one of 1 feature pairs at or above the 0.75 redundancy threshold.
vol_21d is the top SHAP feature in 13/21 folds: the model leans on one feature family rather than a diversified signal.
The model's daily rank correlation with momentum is only 0.0005: it is not a noisy copy of momentum.

Model fold-IC std/|mean| is 3.32 vs momentum's 1.61, and the two sides' fold-level IC are correlated at only 0.180 across folds: the model's edge is less stable fold to fold, and a good or bad fold for one does not predict a good or bad fold for the other.
On 91.9% of rebalance days the model's tail picks diverge from momentum's; on those days the model's realized tail spread is about 8.1x smaller than momentum's, with a 51.5% losing-swap rate.
Model turnover (68.2% per rebalance) is far higher than momentum's (15.4%): more trading without a matching payoff.

Refit of the final CV fold (400 trees, 122436 training rows) shows a mean of 27.7 leaves per tree against the configured cap of 31 (max observed 31), with 14.0% of trees hitting the num_leaves cap. This does not show num_leaves consistently binding in this fold; min_child_samples or max_depth may be the tighter constraint here instead.
